correctness.rationale: All perfect matchings of Q4 are captured exactly once by assigning each of eight even vertices a distinct odd neighbour. Two perfect matchings are adjacent precisely when their symmetric difference is one connected alternating 4- or 6-cycle: the component is 2-regular on 4 or 6 vertices. A separately written all-pairs test enumerated 272 matchings, 768 square and 1216 six-cycle edges. All-source BFS reached all 272 vertices and independently recovered unordered pair histogram {1:1984,2:10784,3:19568,4:4520}, sum 36856, and eccentricity 4 at all 272 sources. Exhaustion is rigorous because every perfect matching is a unique even-to-odd bijection and every move is characterized by the symmetric difference. The result is exactly for labelled Q4, not higher-dimensional dimer dynamics.
